## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing and SPY (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND with TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND implying SPY/TLT ↑ rising; HYG (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND also supports credit stress easing.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds positive: SPY (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND with TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND (SPY/TLT ↑ rising); Reflation/recovery signals from CPER (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing financial conditions: UUP (Dollar proxy) (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND showing a softer dollar, while HYG (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +1.76%) and LQD (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND signal credit stress ↓ falling; yield curve in RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership: SPY (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND; EMs catching up: EEM (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND; China mixed: FXI (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL while China tech metrics are underperforming relative to US.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation elevated: ARKK (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +7.52%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +3.42% | 1M: +8.42%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +1.48%) ABOVE TREND—risk-on sentiment supporting risk assets.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Cyclicals/reflation bias: CPER (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY showing raw-material strength; Gold GLD (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -4.34%) RECOVERY—profit-taking over the month but short-term bid.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weakness: XLE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -13.35%) BELOW TREND—commodity energy components under pressure.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad risk-on signals with SPY (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Commodities/gold show RECOVERY vs month weakness (GLD (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -4.34%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY) — minor divergence to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum ETFs such as XLK (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy risk ETFs like XLE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND and natural gas UNG (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -13.35%) BELOW TREND; bonds/TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND remain less attractive.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND and Semiconductors SOXX (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -2.29%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial reflation CPER (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND and Silver SLV (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -13.35%) BELOW TREND and broad oil BNO (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX/VXX complacency area: VIX ~29 with VXX (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND; Credit health: HYG/LQD spread supportive with HYG (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.57%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF leadership gap to watch for rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive confirmed by VXX (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND. Technology and semiconductors are showing strength (XLK (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk: commodities and gold show short-term RECOVERY vs monthly weakness (GLD (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -4.34%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY) — monitor for rotation into cyclicals or a reacceleration of inflation signals.
